I completely understand your situation. However, once an order is already out for delivery, our delivery partners operate on strict routing systems, and even our supervisors cannot manually override or update the address in the system at this final stage. 

If the delivery agent is unable to reach you, the order will be marked as undelivered and returned to our warehouse. Once it is cancelled and processed for return, a full refund will be credited to your account, and you can easily place a new order with your parents' address. 

Would you like me to go ahead and flag this order for cancellation so your refund can be processed smoothly?
